profile.headline: Software Engineer @Microsoft | Former Sales Engineer
profile.summary:
Landing in the tech industry as a Software Engineer, I pivoted my career from chemical engineering during the pandemic, and Ada Developers Academy supported me with mentoring, resources, and education to achieve my goals to develop full stack projects collaborate with talented engineers and complete 5 months internship program at Microsoft. Now, I'm experienced in backend, frontend, and DevOps, and I've worked on full-stack projects primarily developed using my favorite languages, Python and JavaScript. 

Currently, I'm looking for full stack roles in software development on a team that allows me to continue learning and level-up my skillset as software engineer.

In my previous four years of experience as a sales engineer, I developed skills such as active listening, negotiation, designing and creating technical training, time management, and goal setting for distributors and myself. These skills have not only helped me as an individual but also as part of a team. Now, I look forward to utilizing them to set new goals as a member of a development team.

Outside of work, I love cooking or baking cookies, hiking with my family and my dog, watching videos about geography or history, and admiring colorful sunsets.

I couldn't be prouder of my decision to change my career, follow my dreams, and be part of the representation of the Latinx community in the tech industry. If you would like to talk, please reach out to me at andrygzt@gmail.com.

Languages: Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript
Frameworks & Libraries: Flask, SQLAlchemy, React, Next.js
Databases: PostgreSQL, Prisma
Cloud Technologies: Azure, GitHub

positions.title: Full Stack Engineering Fellow
positions.description: Selected for a highly competitive Fellowship designed to uplevel software engineering knowledge and skills through individualized curriculum to target growth areas and personalized coaching from industry leading software engineers.

positions.title: Software Developer Engineer
positions.description:
Rectified and configured a continuous integration pipeline for pre-production and production environments to replace a previous manual task, saving time for three different teams. 

Created documentation for the organization’s Wiki page, with detailed least-privilege access schema and descriptions of pipeline jobs, steps, tasks, and variables. 

Technologies: Azure (Blob storage, container and key vault managing), YAML Schema and Azure DevOps.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Documentation · Azure Key Vault · Azure Container · Pipelines · Azure Storage · Azure Active Directory · Microsoft Azure · Wiki Development · YAML · Azure DevOps · Pipeline Construction · Azure Blob Storage · Azure Administrator · Azure Virtual Machines

positions.title: Student Software Developer
positions.description: Education in web applications software development complemented with self advocacy.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Firebase · Databases · JavaScript · HTML · Software Testing · Postman API · OAuth · React.js · API Development · REST APIs · SQL · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: LA Sales Representative
positions.description:
International brand management and representation in 8 Latin America Countries. Identified and onboarded 5 new distributors in 3 different countries in 1 year.
-	To provide technical support and training to customers out of the country, average of 120 customers.
-	I coordinated and trained my team to create, film, and publish an average of 6 live technical product trainings per month (Jan - Sep 2021). 
Each training was specially created according to most common customer's technical questions in the company YouTube Channel or via Zoom meetings.	

Introduced the idea of using WhatsApp Messenger service to be used by the sales team. I presented and convinced upper management to implement the plan, I defined steps of the process, and implemented the use of WhatsApp as an additional channel of communication with customers since this app is the most popular instant messaging tool in Latin-American countries and due time zone differences was crucial to contact them during core hours. Savings around $11,400 USD/year.
positions.insights: Skills: Negotiation · Brand Development · Active Listening · Key Account Relationship Building · CRM · Key Account Acquisition & Retention
